English: Craft Guild Hut
A humble cluster of makeshift shelters where the first artisans gather, trading skills and simple goods among earthen floors and woven mats.
Scribes' Niche
A modest chamber where literate guildsmen record transactions and tally accounts, marking the first steps toward organized civic administration.
Potters' Court
A small, sun-baked courtyard lined with simple pottery wheels and kilns, producing everyday wares for the growing settlement.
Weavers' Lane
A row of reed and mud workshops where cloth is spun and dyed, bringing color and comfort to the settlements trade.
Merchants' Yard
A walled enclosure of stone warehouses and counting houses, where merchants gather under the protection of the guilds authority.
Artisans' Plaza
A bustling central square of timber and brick, where skilled craftsmen display their wares, attracting merchants and fostering urban growth.
Jewelers' Row
A stately avenue of well-guarded shops, where precious gems and gold are worked, attracting wealth and prestige from distant lands.
Guild Assembly
A grand hall of the urban guilds, where leaders meet, regulate trade, and make civic decisions, strengthening city governance and defense.
Market Enclosure
A fortified, bustling market ringed by permanent stone arcades and watchtowers, drawing traders from afar and defending the citys prosperity.
Grand Urban Guild
The ultimate urban institution: a magnificent, multi-storied guild complex at the heart of the city, dominating commerce, administration, and civic life in all directions.
